en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 260 points to end seven-day slide
en.dek: The benchmark finished at 22,226 points, up about 1.2 percent, after gains narrowed in the afternoon; turnover exceeded HK$212.4 billion.
body: Hong Kong stocks ended a seven-day losing streak on Thursday as the Hang Seng Index closed at 22,226 points, up 260 points or about 1.2 percent. The index had risen more than 500 points in the morning session before gains narrowed in the afternoon.

Turnover exceeded HK$212.4 billion. The Hang Seng Tech Index rose more than 1 percent to 3,417 points, ending an 11-day decline. Major technology stocks advanced, with Meituan among the stronger performers.

AI-related shares were generally higher, with some rebounding between 4 and 8 percent. Automakers were mixed: Li Auto rose about 8 percent after reporting results, while BYD fell nearly 2 percent. Mainland banks and energy stocks also gained.
The close confirmed the midday rebound reported earlier, with the market recovering from recent losses led by technology shares.

zh.headline: 恒指收市升260點結束7連跌 報22226點
zh.dek: 指數午後升幅收窄，全日成交逾2124億元；科技指數升逾1%結束11連跌。
body: 港股周四結束7日跌勢，恒生指數收報22226點，升260點，升幅約1.2%。指數早段曾升逾500點，但午後升幅收窄。
全日成交額逾2124億元。恒生科技指數升逾1%報3417點，結束11連跌。主要科技股普遍上升，美團表現較好。
人工智能相關股份普遍向好，部分反彈4%至逾8%。汽車股走勢不一，理想汽車公布業績後升約8%，比亞迪則跌近2%。內銀及能源股亦上升。
收市確認早市反彈，市場在科技股帶動下從近日跌勢回升。
